version: HuggingFace dataset revision tracked as allenai/scifact; record the exact commit/revision when downloading for a frozen evaluation.
task: Scientific claim verification: SUPPORT, CONTRADICT, or not enough information (NEI).
intended_metrics: macro F1 over SUPPORTED / CONTRADICTED / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
false-positive analysis (definitive predictions on NEI claims)
citation: Wadden et al. (2020), Fact or Fiction: Verifying Scientific Claims, EMNLP 2020.
usage_note: The dataset is not redistributed in this repository. Download it separately and record the revision used.
